title: Super7 ThunderCats Deluxe Monkian 7" Action Figure Exclusive NIB 2024 Sealed
descriptionText:
Super7 ThunderCats Deluxe Monkian 7" action figure, exclusive. New in box, factory sealed.
Monkian is one of the Mutants of Plun-Darr, the villains from the classic ThunderCats cartoon. Recommended for ages 15 and up. A great addition for ThunderCats collectors. Please see the photos for the condition of the box.
